results.overview: Couples compete against each other to renovate houses and sell them at auction for the highest price.
results.name: The Block

results.overview: Business and life partners Lauren and David Liess run a renovation and design company in Great Falls, Virginia, just outside of Washington DC. Together with the help of friend and contractor, Mike Carr, they're known for designing practical homes with a signature design aesthetic they've coined 'relaxed luxury.' With a passion for design that reflects real life, Liess and Company always delivers a sophisticated and comfortable haven.
results.name: Best House on the Block
